items.title: Home-swapping holidays surge among China retirees to travel affordably, foster connections
items.summary: A growing number of Chinese retirees are embracing home-swapping holidays, exchanging keys with strangers to travel on a budget and expand their social circles. The concept dates back to European teachers in the 1950s and gained global popularity through the 2006 film The Holiday.

items.title: U.S. judge orders Iowa to allow Satanic Temple to hold one-day holiday event in the state Capitol
items.summary: A federal judge on Monday ordered Iowa state officials to allow a local Satanic Temple organization to hold a holiday event in the rotunda of the state Capitol after years of rejecting their application.

Chinese, Russian defence officials hail stronger-than-ever ties
items.summary: Beijing and Moscow hailed stronger-than-ever relations on Tuesday, as Russia’s Defence Minister Andrei Belousov visited the Chinese capital to promote military ties between the two countries.

items.title: Gas leak in Milton ‘dealt with’, residents returned home
items.summary: Police say the gas leak in Milton on Monday evening has been “dealt with.”

items.title: Students blockade dozens of French schools and universities
items.summary: Students blockaded dozens of high schools and universities across France on Tuesday to maintain pressure on the government over education reforms as trade unions prepared for a nationwide strike.

items.title: King Charles III speaks to world leaders in Antigua, expresses ‘sorrow’ over slave trade
items.summary: ST. JOHN’S, Antigua (AP) — King Charles III called the transatlantic slave trade a “shameful chapter of history” during a speech Tuesday at the official opening of the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Antigua.

items.title: No injuries after shelter-in-place order issued at University of Toronto Mississauga campus
items.summary: Police say there is no ongoing threat to public safety after the University of Toronto issued a shelter-in-place order for its Mississauga campus.
